notes.title: Disney Infinity 2.0: Gold Edition - Dec. 16th Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27118125/66c3bca7cfe8c693d0ec22b80c37c55441cd6a77.png[/img]

[b][u]Disney Infinity 2.0: Gold Edition - December 16, 2016 Update[/u][/b]
We are happy to have addressed some of the most requested changes.

Fixes Include:
- Game can now run in Offline Mode
- Fixed Save Game Migration
- Fixed performance issues in the ToyBox
- Incorporated Improved Camera from Disney Infinity 3.0

Thanks for your continued support.
